verdict.rationale: Grafana provides a documented provisioning system for version-controlled dashboards/data sources, plus an explicit 'observability as code' workflow supporting Terraform-style/API-driven config, version control, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment, backed by a CLI for automation. missing for 10: independent hands-on case study of Terraform provider usage in production and explicit mention of alert-as-code provisioning depth beyond dashboards/data sources.
